full_judgment: 35. However, in view of the arguments placed before us a query has been made from the Bench, as to whether the amendment made in section '5GaGa, in the BCA, 1991, in 2023, will have any retrospective effect as regards the plaintiff Nos. 2-10, who have signed the personal euarantees on 20-7-2011. The learned Advocate for the appellant submits that, the substantive law is presumed to be prospective in operation. However, the presumption as to the prospective operation of the substantive law is not rigid, nor an inflexible rule of interpretation of statute. We are not required to deliberate upon this issue for disposal of the present Rule.
